messages:
deploy-bot: Deploy finished to eu1: service/inference v2.14.0 -> v2.15.0 (rollout 12%). commit abcdef12. canary checks passed at deploy time. https://ci/release/abcdef12

maya: Heads-up — synth probe for /v1/embed started showing 503 pulses in eu1 around +90s after rollout. not all hosts, looks concentrated on a small subset.

maya: quick log tail:
```
[2026-03-23T10:12:10Z] host=eu1-k8s-node-7 service=inference route=/v1/embed resp=503 count=18
[2026-03-23T10:12:12Z] host=eu1-k8s-node-9 service=inference route=/v1/embed resp=503 count=21
[2026-03-23T10:12:15Z] host=eu1-k8s-node-7 service=inference route=/v1/embed resp=200 count=3
```

aj: Thanks, looking. Are 503s correlated with CPU OOMs or queueBackpressure? can you dump the host-level kube events?

maya: grabbing events now. no OOMs visible. pod restarts = 0. k8s evts show some tcp-reset from envoy on node-9.

sre-lina: Observed p95 embed latency jump in eu1 canary cluster at +2m: p95 980ms -> 1.8s and an increase in 503 rate to 0.6% overall. Canary is small, but spike is real.

ops-jordan: If it's isolated to a few nodes we can quarantine them from the LB instead of full rollback. Suggest temporarily removing eu1-k8s-node-7 and -9 from traffic, continue rollout pause.

product-sam: What's customer-visible here? any user-facing errors reported?

maya: so far only internal synthetic probes and a handful of 5xx traces from a couple of paying customers (3 distinct accounts) routed through eu1. Not a wide outage, but unacceptable risk if rollout continues.

deploy-bot: Canary metrics snapshot: commit=abcdef12, canary_nodes=6, healthy=5, recent_503s=39, recent_200s=620. Link: https://metrics/commit/abcdef12

aj: Quick diagnosis plan: 1) isolate suspect hosts, 2) pin eu1 traffic to stable variant (v2.14.0) while we investigate, 3) capture full traces & KV-cache heatmap from the failing nodes.

release-zoe: How do we want to "pin" region routing? do we have an urgent route change runbook?

ops-jordan: Runbook command (runs in infra-admin):
```bash
# divert eu1 to stable release entirely
routectl set-route --region eu1 --target release:v2.14.0 --weight 100 --reason "post-deploy 503 spike"
```

sre-lina: I'll prepare a canary snapshot and a flamegraph collector on node-7/9. please don't roll forward more than current 12% until we decide.

deploy-bot: Rollout paused by release-zoe. No further batches will be released.

product-sam: OK. Please notify support & update release notes with a short blurb. I'll prep a status line for customers if it grows.

maya: Captured traces show repeated upstream connection resets between envoy and local inference process on node-9. Trying to reproduce with a local load test against node-9 IP.

aj: If envoy <-> model process resets, could be a socket backlog or file descriptor exhaustion. Check `ulimit -n` and listen queue. Also check kernel dmesg for 'conn reset' spikes.

maya: ulimit looks normal. kernel shows tcp_close_wait spikes around the same time. attaching snippet: 
```
netstat -anp | grep TIME_WAIT | wc -l -> 4200
ss -s shows tcp: sockets in CLOSE_WAIT increased rapidly
```

ops-jordan: Given the evidence, temporary region re-route + host quarantine is the least disruptive. I'll execute the routectl change once a second ops approves.

aj: Approve. Also create a short-lived firewall rule to remove node-9 from LB pool if needed.

release-zoe: I'm making a quick internal release note: "eu1 rollout paused after post-deploy probe detected elevated 503s on a subset of nodes; rollback avoided by routing eu1 to stable release and quarantining affected hosts; investigating root cause."

deploy-bot: Route change applied: eu1 -> release:v2.14.0 (effective at 10:19Z). Quarantine commands queued for node-7 and node-9.

maya: Re-run synth probe after route change — embed route 200s restored, 503s back down to baseline. Confirmed no further customer 5xx after diversion.

product-sam: Thanks team. Can we add a follow-up action to the release with severity=high for root cause and safety net? I'll file the ticket.

aj: I'll take lead on postmortem and propose a mitigation (increase envoy listen backlog tuning + improved probe coverage for per-host health).

sre-lina: Add automated host-level netstat sampling for the first 10 minutes after rollouts as part of canary checks.

release-zoe: Agree. I'll mark the release as "paused - region reverted" and schedule a retest once fixes merged.

ops-jordan: Leaving a note in the deploy channel: `diverted eu1 traffic to v2.14.0 at 10:19Z, quarantined eu1-k8s-node-7/9, rollback not performed`.

maya: Good job. I'll keep digging on why the connection resets occurred and share traces in the ticket. :mag_right:

product-sam: Ping me if we need to notify the small set of affected customers.

release-zoe: Closing thread for now. Follow-up ticket: INF-4321 (investigate eu1 post-deploy 503 pulse)
